membershipPlans.name: Individual Membership
membershipPlans.description: 2027 Run NS Membership for new and returning members.
features: Iconic annual Run Nova Scotia tech shirt in new seasonal color
5% or more discount on all sanctioned Road Race Series events
Official point accumulation in Road Race & Performance Series
Exclusive member-only newsletter with race guides & tips
Invitation to exclusive Guesstimate Run & Year-End Celebration
Voting rights at the Run Nova Scotia Annual General Meeting

membershipPlans.name: Perpetual Membership
membershipPlans.description: Must be at least 65 years old. This buys you a Run NS membership for life!
features: Lifetime membership — never pay annual dues again
Annual iconic member tech shirt mailed or given at races every season
Guaranteed 5%+ discount on every RNS sanctioned road race for life
Permanent inclusion in historic Run Nova Scotia age-class leaderboards
Complimentary invitation to special master class recognitions
Full voting rights and lifetime camaraderie

membershipBenefitsList.title: Iconic Annual Tech Shirt
membershipBenefitsList.desc: A collector's item since 1984! Every season features a brand new vibrant colorway crafted from premium moisture-wicking technical fabric.

membershipBenefitsList.title: 5%+ Registration Discounts
membershipBenefitsList.desc: Save money every time you register for any of our 20+ sanctioned Road Race Series events across Nova Scotia via Race Roster.

membershipBenefitsList.title: Age-Class Series Points
membershipBenefitsList.desc: Earn official points at every race competing against peers in your exact age and gender bracket. Accumulate points towards year-end trophies.

membershipBenefitsList.title: Year-End Celebration & Banquet
membershipBenefitsList.desc: Celebrate at our legendary year-end awards gala with medals, great food, prize giveaways, and stories shared among lifelong running friends.

membershipBenefitsList.title: Pre-Season Guesstimate Run
membershipBenefitsList.desc: Run without watches or GPS in our fan-favorite spring tradition where runners predict their finish time to win bragging rights and prizes.

membershipBenefitsList.title: Community & Club Network
membershipBenefitsList.desc: Connect with local running groups from Yarmouth to Sydney, find training partners, pace groups, and volunteer opportunities.
